headline: Seed pinning reaches 24 titles
lede: SEEDPIN batch 3 lands on main: OUTPOST, BLOB BATTLE and PAPERS, PLEASE-MIN now report their seed with every feedback note and replay the exact world from ?seed=N — the last single-player sims before the big engines.

notes.text: Batch 3 of the #1473 rollout merged as d7c5cec: three more arcade titles carry their seed in production reports. A filed report now replays the same cave, the same garbage order, the same week of applicants.

Blob Battle pins offline matches only — online duels keep the lobby seed, so two seats can never desync from a URL trick. Digit picks stay explicit: ?seed=N replaces the default start, not your choice.
feedbackcheck's rollout floor rose 21 to 24: if any of these titles ever stops reporting or honoring its seed, CI goes red. Mutant-proven: one stripped pin and the law fails loudly.
This lane took the stage over after the holding slot went silent past the 90-minute liveness window — batch 3 was designed on the issue but never pushed; it ships now.
